cards.essence: This is the energy that makes things. It is the push in you to make something that was not there before, and to make it your own way, and it keeps no schedule. It comes when it comes. While it is in, you are all the way in: the days have colour, the work gets you out of bed, and stopping is not something you could do if you tried. When it goes out there is nothing, and nothing you do brings it back a day sooner. Then one morning it is there again, and what it carries in is the start of something new.

glance.reading:
This is the energy that makes things. It is the push in you to make something that was not there before, and to make it your own way, and it keeps no schedule. It comes when it comes. While it is in, you are all the way in: the days have colour, the work gets you out of bed, and stopping is not something you could do if you tried. When it goes out there is nothing, and nothing you do brings it back a day sooner. Then one morning it is there again, and what it carries in is the start of something new.

Carried well it is fresh, and fresh means you are not afraid of getting it wrong. Everything new is found by trying the wrong thing first, many times over, until the right one shows itself, so you begin before you know how it ends. The idea moves one way and then another as it comes into the world, and you let it, because an idea held too tightly goes out like a small fire under a closed hand. What comes out could only have come from you. And it works on you while you work on it. By the end you have been changed as much as the material has, and that change is the beautiful part, more than the thing on the table.

The stretch between waves is the part most people get wrong. It looks like nothing is happening, and something is: whatever comes next is being made where you cannot see it, and it needs you quiet and mostly alone. Do not go looking for the reason you feel flat, and do not try to fix it. Asking what is wrong with you is what turns a flat week into a flat year. Rest, keep your own company, and let it come back in its own time. It returns the way it left, all at once.

iching.trigram_combination: Heaven over Heaven: the sky, and under it the sky again, with nothing anywhere in it that gives. This is strength with nothing in it that yields, moving the way the sky moves, with no pause anywhere in the day or the night. Its creature is the dragon, which sleeps the winter at the bottom of deep water, wakes in spring, and climbs, up through the open field and on into the sky, and keeps climbing. The old sign for it is vapour lifting off wet ground under a strong sun, and the same word, said another way, means to parch.
iching.reading:
You are at the start of something, and the whole of its life is still in front of it. Everything that starts passes through four seasons: it springs up, it grows, it is gathered in, and then it is tested to see what it was worth. You stand at the first, and the counsel is to look at all four from here, because the thing will not be yours until it has been through the last, and that takes longer than a beginning ever thinks it will.

What it asks of you is to keep going and not to push. The sky is the picture: it moves all day and all night and it never strains, and that is why it never wears out. Make yourself strong the same way, by using your strength a little every day rather than spending it all in one blaze. Before you set out, take a breath and be sure of who you are and where you came from, because a force this size will carry you a long way in whatever direction you happen to be facing. And know that the one danger in it is going too far: it can burn what it has made before the thing has taken shape, and the person who cannot stop ends up sorry.

This energy has a place in the body, and it is the head. Notice where you are holding yourself right now: up, at the top, in the eyes and the forehead, already looking at what comes next. The beginning of a thing is felt there before the hands get any of it. So stand the way the sky moves: steady, unhurried, and never once straining.
judgement_lines: Heaven begins. What it begins goes the whole way through: it springs, it grows, it is gathered in, it is tried.
It goes well for the one who holds to what is true.
image_lines: The movement of the sky has strength in it, and it does not let up.
So the wise make themselves strong, day after day, and do not tire.

upper_trigram.name: Heaven (Ch'ien)
upper_trigram.nature: Unceasing forward movement, dynamic, enduring, untiring. Spirit power. Heaven, sovereign, father.

lower_trigram.name: Heaven (Ch'ien)
lower_trigram.nature: Unceasing forward movement, dynamic, enduring, untiring. Spirit power. Heaven, sovereign, father.

lines.image: a dragon under the water, not to be used yet.
lines.reading: There is something with real strength in it lying low in you, and it is not time. From the surface the water looks still; underneath, a great deal is moving. If you bring it up now, before it is ripe, it will be spent on the first thing it meets and there will be none left for the thing it was for. So do not act on the first push. Feed what is down there where nobody is watching, and let it grow in the dark for as long as it needs. When it does come up, it will have somewhere to go.

lines.image: a dragon come up into the open field, and someone worth going to see.
lines.reading: What was under the water is out in the open now, in a field where anyone can see it. The place has changed from deep water to open ground, and the strength in you is the same in both. You have ability and people have noticed it, and you do not yet have the judgement to use it well; those are two different things, and only one of them is yours so far. This is the time to find the one person who has walked further than you and put yourself where they can see you. Be careful who else you stand with, because what is like you makes you stronger and what is not wears you thin. Then show yourself.

lines.image: working the whole day through, and still awake to the danger at nightfall.
lines.reading: You are past the beginning and short of the height, and this is the exposed place: not down in the field where nobody expected much, not up in the sky where the thing is done. You have the strength for the work and the whole weight of what it is for, so you work all day, and when the light goes you are still awake, going over what you did and what you missed. Part of the danger is real, and part of it is your own hurry to arrive. Neither is a fault. Work while there is light. When it goes, keep watch over what you have built, go carefully, and nothing will go wrong.

lines.image: a leap up out of the deep, or a while longer in it, and either is allowed.
lines.reading: You have come to a fork, and for once nothing is wrong on either side of it. You can rise now and live in the open, where the work is seen, or go back down for a while and live in the deep, where the work is yours alone, and both roads come out somewhere good. The hesitating you feel is not weakness. It is you checking, and the checking is exactly why no harm comes of this. So look at the weather before you move. Going back down is not a defeat here. Sometimes you step back to get the run-up for the leap.

lines.image: a dragon up in the open sky, and the great one there to be seen.
lines.reading: The strength is at its full height and out where everyone can see it. What is flying now is the same thing that hid, then showed itself, then kept watch, then leaped; none of that was wasted, and this is what it was for. At this height like draws like: clouds follow a dragon the way wind follows a tiger, and the people who gather round you now are the ones with something of the same in them. Go and find them. What you have reached is not for you alone, and the way to keep it is to spend it, on whoever it can help, whenever the chance comes. Do not leave that for later. Even at the height there is such a thing as late.

lines.image: a dragon climbed past the top of the sky, with nowhere further to go.
lines.reading: You have gone one step past the top, and the strength that carried you here knows only one direction, which is on. So you are still going, though it is late and the friends who came up with you have gone home. Up here you are high with nobody beside you and nobody under you, and a strength like that cannot give life to anything any more; it can only burn. The regret you feel is not the failure. It is the turn, the one thing that ever brought a proud strength back down. A bow is not kept drawn all day. Learn to come down the way you learned to rise, and come down while it is still yours to choose.

gene_keys.shadow:
At its lowest, this energy goes flat, and the days go flat with it. You get to the end of one tired and cannot say what it was for. The work has no light in it and neither do the people, and the street you live on and the things you watch all seem to take a little more out of you than they give. This is numbness. It is a feeling, though almost nobody knows they are in it, and knowing is most of the way out. You will do nearly anything rather than feel it: reach for the phone, the fridge, someone to ring, the next thing to do, and each one works for about a minute. And if you set out to find the reason for the flat, or to fix it, it sets hard, and a low that would have passed in a week is with you for a year. The more you are someone who makes things, the deeper these days go.

The way through starts with a hand on your chest. Notice how little is there, and let that be allowed. Nothing has left you. The low is not empty; it is a gathering, and something you cannot see yet is being made in the dark, the way a fire is laid before anyone strikes a match. It came on by itself, and if you leave it alone it goes the same way, and until then it wants you quiet and mostly on your own. What you are waiting for begins here, under the flat, whether or not you can feel it stirring.
gene_keys.repressive: Here is the person the flat closes over. Fear gets into it, and the fear freezes the low in place, and the low goes on drawing energy away from the surface of their life until the shine is gone from their eyes and some days the bed is as far as they get. It can last a season or it can last years. Nobody else can walk them out. Only they can, by turning round and facing the fear that froze it.
gene_keys.reactive: Here is the person who cannot bear the flat for one minute. The moment it arrives they fill every hour and call everyone they know, and the schemes get wilder or the days get more mechanical, anything to get away from what is going on inside. Everything in the body is saying go down and be still, and they go the other way, and the body pays for it in the end.
gene_keys.gift:
Met and let in, this energy is the light coming back. One morning the colour is in things again, the sadness has switched to joy with no more warning than it came, and with the joy comes something you have to say or make, in your voice or with your hands. What comes out is new: not new the way a thing from a shop is new, new the way a fire is new, alive and burning. You are not afraid of getting it wrong. There is no path and you make one by walking, and most of the paths are dead ends, and the dead ends are how the real one is found. You can promise a thing before you know what is in it, and by the time it is due it has arrived. When it is finished you let it go, because you were never more than the one who was there when it happened.

Where this is at its best is a small room: a family, a few people who work together, a table of friends. Give it the floor at the right moment and the whole room wakes up, and you never wanted to be followed, and people follow anyway. Then leave, sooner than seems polite. Fresh things do not keep, and the same you that lit the room can drain it if you stay past the release. All of this is made from the flat days. What was laid in the dark while nothing showed is what catches now, and you do not get the one without the other. You cannot make it come, and when it goes you cannot call it back; what you can do is be alone well, and trust your own timing over anyone's.
gene_keys.siddhi:
At its height, everything you look at is beautiful. A face, a field at first light, a grey week in the middle of winter, each one shines with being exactly what it is, and it is all one light. This is what happens when you have given yourself to what you make so completely that it has remade you, and there is nothing left of you standing between you and what you see. It is delicate. There is an old story of a student who sat a whole dawn on a mountain beside his teacher, and at the sun's rising said one word, beautiful, and was spoken of afterwards as rather a noisy fellow. One word is enough to crack it. So you say less, and see more.

This is what the fire becomes when there is no longer anyone it is happening to. The one who was afraid to get it wrong, and then unafraid, has been burned away with the rest, and what is made now comes through you and goes out with nobody's name on it. Even the flat days are beautiful from here, because they were part of the making. It cannot be taught. All you can do is live it where people can see, and some will resent it, and some will come and stand in the light.
gene_keys.programming_partner: Beyond the Shell stands opposite you a second time, and this time it is the lows and the heights that are paired. At the bottom the two make each other worse: the flat days here want to be left alone, and the lost feeling there cannot leave anything alone and starts asking what is wrong, and the asking is what sets the flat hard. At the top they are one thing, the beauty of a single thing and the whole it belongs to. Open it when the low has turned into worry about the low, because it knows the way home when you cannot feel one.

human_design.gate:
As a pressure in the body, the energy that makes things is the push to make them your own way. Gate 1 is the door it comes through: the push to put what is inside you out where it can be seen, in your shape and nobody else's. Nobody taught you the style; it is the one you had as a child, before anyone told you how things are done. In you it runs as an itch to make the thing and to say it the way you would say it, and when there is nowhere for that to go you are miserable and cannot always say why. When it does get out, the people near you feel more like themselves for having seen it.

From outside, doing it your way every time can look like stubbornness. What is going on is simpler: the making and the self are one movement, and asking a person like this to do it the usual way is asking them to be someone else. The cost is that you are misunderstood more than most, and a bad word about the work lands like a bad word about you. The people who carry this all their lives learn two things: that being different is the strength and not the fault, and that trying to be original on purpose is the one thing that chokes it.
human_design.centre:
Seen through this lens, this pressure rises from the centre of the chest, the Identity Centre, which holds who you are and which way your life faces. It has no engine of its own. It works by drawing: the people and the work and the places that belong in your life are pulled toward it, and what goes out through Gate 1 is that self showing its face. When you trust it, it sets the direction. When you do not, you end up fighting what it was already bringing you.

In about six people in ten this centre is switched on, and the self stays put whoever they are with. For someone like that, what they make carries one signature all their life, and the thing that starves them is being made to work in another person's manner; they tend to think everyone should be going their way, and if they give up their own way to follow someone else's, something in the chest goes out. In the other four it is open, and the sense of self is borrowed from whoever is nearest and let go when they leave. For someone like that, this pressure is one of the few places they feel solid. In the act of making they are somebody, for as long as the making lasts, and even where they sit in a room can change what they make.
human_design.channel: What rises from the chest has no voice of its own. The half it lacks is Gate 8, up in the throat, the pressure to bring something to the group and have it count. The Channel of Inspiration runs between the two, and when it is whole, what was only yours becomes something other people can pick up and carry. This is a channel that waits. It speaks best when someone has asked to hear it and worst when it has pushed its way into the room, which is why a person who carries it whole can spend years feeling overlooked before they learn to wait for the asking. Whether the other half sits in you or in someone near you, nothing crosses until both ends are lit.

tarot.ring_role: A family of two, the smallest kind there is. The other is Ancestors Bloom, the same fire a season on, with a harvest standing round it. Here it is the first catch, with nothing to burn yet and needing nothing. There the heat has something to feed and something to give away. What both know is what a fire costs: while it burns everyone gathers, when it drops to a flicker you are nobody, and forcing it back up is how you end up making bargains with yourself. Open it when the beginning has caught and you want to see what the burning was for.
tarot.tarot_resonance: The dragon climbs into a sky that never stops, and one face waits for it up there.

body.physiology:
The liver is the largest organ inside you, tucked up under the right side of your ribs, and of the organs inside you it is the one that grows back. Take most of it away and within months it has rebuilt itself to size. Nearly everything the gut takes from a meal goes there first. It takes the sugar and stores it, and between meals lets it out again a little at a time, so that your blood holds one level whether you ate an hour ago or ten hours ago. It breaks down what is finished with and builds much of what the blood carries. All of this goes on while you sleep, and none of it asks you. Of everything in you, it is the part built to start again.

You can find it. Lay your right hand flat under the lowest rib on that side and breathe in as deep as you can. The liver sits just under the sheet of muscle that does your breathing, so the breath in pushes it down toward your fingers, and in some people its edge can be felt arriving. On the breath out it rises back. It goes down and comes up like that with every breath you take, and the work never stops for any of them.
body.amino_acid:
Lysine is the knot in the rope that holds you together. The rope is collagen, and there is more of it in you than of any other protein: it runs through your skin and your tendons and the frame of your bones. Collagen is strong because its strands are tied to one another, and the ties are made at this one building block and nowhere else. Take it away and the strands slide apart.

Your body cannot make it, so it comes in with food: meat, fish, eggs, beans and lentils are full of it, and grain is short of it, which is why beans over rice make a whole protein where either alone falls short. Reach down and take hold of the thick cord above your heel, and try to bend it sideways. It will not go. That cord is collagen taking the pull, knotted at lysine, and it will take that pull ten thousand times tomorrow without a thought from you.

relations.unity_line: The kin here are what a beginning needs and does not have: somewhere to land, something to feed, and a hand on the measure.

pair.teaching: Beyond the Shell is the ground this strength comes down onto, the same first act seen from underneath. Here everything pushes and nothing takes; there nothing pushes, and what is handed over is carried the whole way to its end. One is the force and the other is the direction, and in that pairing it is the ground that decides where the force goes. Open it when you have begun something and it will not go anywhere, because what a beginning needs next is not more push. It needs somewhere to land.

inverse.teaching: Turn the six lines over and they come back the same, one of only eight that do. A strength that is all one kind has no other face to show, no underneath, nothing waiting behind the first look. What looks back at you is the same rising you started with, and there is nothing else to open here.

programming_partner.teaching: Beyond the Shell stands opposite you a second time, and this time it is the lows and the heights that are paired. At the bottom the two make each other worse: the flat days here want to be left alone, and the lost feeling there cannot leave anything alone and starts asking what is wrong, and the asking is what sets the flat hard. At the top they are one thing, the beauty of a single thing and the whole it belongs to. Open it when the low has turned into worry about the low, because it knows the way home when you cannot feel one.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Fire
codon_ring.teaching: A family of two, the smallest kind there is. The other is Ancestors Bloom, the same fire a season on, with a harvest standing round it. Here it is the first catch, with nothing to burn yet and needing nothing. There the heat has something to feed and something to give away. What both know is what a fire costs: while it burns everyone gathers, when it drops to a flicker you are nobody, and forcing it back up is how you end up making bargains with yourself. Open it when the beginning has caught and you want to see what the burning was for.

tarot.teaching: The dragon climbs into a sky that never stops, and one face waits for it up there.

sky.teaching: the archer, a fire sign, and the arrow already off the string toward a mark the archer has not seen yet. Strength here is what has been let go, not what is being held.

immortals.teaching: The sky is doubled, so one immortal stands for both halves. Han Xiangzi is the one with the flute. In the stories he left a scholar's house for the mountains, having no use for what could be learned at a desk, and when he played, flowers came out in the wrong season. That is this strength in a small instrument: breath with a shape put on it, and things growing that were not due yet.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the tent peg driven into the ground, the small fixed thing that lets a whole roof stand up and take the wind. Even a strength that never stops needs one point that does not move.

cards.essence: Something has been handed to you and it is yours to bring through. The bringing does not need you out in front of it. You can feel how much is being held and how little you are doing to hold it, and the ease of that is what being carried feels like. The ground under you is doing what ground does.

glance.reading:
Something has been handed to you and it is yours to bring through. The bringing does not need you out in front of it. You can feel how much is being held and how little you are doing to hold it, and the ease of that is what being carried feels like. The ground under you is doing what ground does.

The pull here is to take the wheel. Being behind a thing feels like being nowhere, and the feeling says that if you set the direction yourself then at least the road is yours. The road was never in doubt. It only needed you on it.

Stay behind it and stay soft. What you are carrying knows where it is going, and it takes you along if you let it. Let things come to you instead of going out to get them. The feeling of being lost is only the feeling of not leading. You were on the way the whole time.

iching.trigram_combination: The ground, and under the ground more ground. Nothing in it rises. Nothing in it strikes. Whatever falls onto it is taken in. Whatever is set into it comes up in its own time. This is the open field with the whole sky for a ceiling and the same field underneath it, holding up everything that stands on it.
iching.reading:
You are being asked to carry something through rather than drive it. Carrying is work of its own. A thing has been set in your hands and it wants bringing to completion, and the bringing is quiet. You will want to get out in front of it and set the pace, so that at least the direction is yours. Go first here and you lose the way at once. Come behind, and what is worth following shows itself.

What this asks is a mare's kind of strength. She can run as far as any horse alive and still she runs behind, along the ground, going where it goes. Keep to your own kind while this lasts. Your kind are the ones who grow things and make things and wait for them. The ones who charge and climb you will lose for now and losing them is part of it. Stay where your footing is sure and the rest takes care of itself.

This force has one place in the body and here it holds it twice over. The belly. The soft front of you that takes in food and carries weight and was never once told how. Put a hand there now and feel how little it is doing and how much it is holding.

Step out ahead of the ground you stand on and you are out of place at once. Hold your place and everything you were given comes to its end in your hands.
judgement_lines: The Receptive. From the source it goes through and grows. Holding firm the way a mare does brings it through.
Set out to lead and you go astray. Follow, and you find the one worth following.
Friends in the south and west. Friends lost in the north and east. Rest in what is steady, and it goes well.
image_lines: The ground lies open under all things. That is the earth's power.
So the wise make themselves broad, and carry the world.

upper_trigram.name: Earth (K'un)
upper_trigram.nature: Surface of the world, support of all existence. Essential Yin. Rest, receptivity.

lower_trigram.name: Earth (K'un)
lower_trigram.nature: Surface of the world, support of all existence. Essential Yin. Rest, receptivity.

lines.image: frost underfoot, and the hard ice still to come.
lines.reading: You step out one morning and the ground is white. Nothing has frozen yet. The frost is the first small sign of a cold that will set hard later. Nothing here is dangerous yet. What it asks is that you notice the small thing while it is small, and take care from the first step, because what sets slowly cannot easily be broken.

lines.image: straight, square and wide, with nothing rehearsed.
lines.reading: When you act from the grain of what you are, the act comes out straight. It keeps its own honest shape and it leaves nobody out. Nothing has to be rehearsed for this and nothing has to be repeated. You do the plain thing once as yourself and it is right everywhere at once. Trying would spoil it. Do it, and others fall into step behind you without being called.

lines.image: a gift kept under the coat, and another's work brought to its end.
lines.reading: You are good at this and the time to show it has not come. Keep what you know inside a closed mouth. If the work belongs to someone above you, do it well and let the credit be theirs. See it through to the end without a word about your part. There will be no finished glory here with your name on it. There will be the thing brought to its end, and the quiet of having done it is yours to keep.

lines.image: the sack tied shut at the neck.
lines.reading: A closed season. Nothing you think gets out and nothing from outside gets in, and the bag is tied at the neck with one emptiness on both sides of the knot. Nobody will blame you for it and nobody will praise you. For now that is exactly right. Keep your plans to yourself. The knot comes loose in its own season, and when it does there is a gladness in it.

lines.image: the yellow garment worn low, under the rest.
lines.reading: Yellow is the colour of the ground and of the middle of things. The garment is worn at the waist, under everything and on show to nobody. You are trusted before you speak. What is good in you shows through of itself and needs no announcing. Having to say what you are is the sign you are not it yet. Wear the good thing low and the ones who belong near you gather on their own.

lines.image: two dragons fighting in the open country, and blood on the ground in the colours of sky and earth.
lines.reading: At the top the yielding has gone hard. It has turned to fight the very thing it was made to receive. Two dragons tear at each other out in the wild and the blood on the grass is dark and yellow. The way has run out, and both sides bleed. If you are the one who set out to rule, stop now. What is torn away here was never meant to be held by force.

gene_keys.shadow:
The lowest form of this energy is a feeling of having stepped off the world. You stand on the same ground as everyone and it does not feel as if it holds you. Somewhere far back a wrong turn was taken and you cannot say where. Since then you have been out of place in every room. It comes out as busyness. The day fills and the load goes onto the shoulders and the hands stay moving, so the hollow underneath cannot be heard. Under the motion is a certainty that life is happening at you and you are not in it. The usual move is to fix the outside. A new plan or a new town or a new job, anything that might close the distance. The relief lasts a few weeks.

You have never left the ground. You cannot, and there was no wrong turn. The feeling is real as a feeling and false as a fact, and it changes the moment it is fully felt instead of outrun. Let it soak all the way in. What you were running from was the longing for home, and the longing is the first sign of the way back.
gene_keys.repressive: Here is someone who has let go of the thread. Nothing larger is expected any more. They follow what serves them this week and call the flatness being sensible. With no felt connection to anything beyond their own life the days have no point they can name, and they get through them.
gene_keys.reactive: There is also the person who lays a grid over life. A system for everything, a doctrine that promises to hold the chaos still. It looks like order. It runs on old anger. The grid keeps the lost feeling at a distance without touching it, and the harder life pushes the tighter it is drawn.
gene_keys.gift:
Met and let in, this energy is the gift of finding your way by being carried. You stop trying to steer and the ground starts moving you. Things begin to line up on their own. The book falls open at the page, the person you needed turns up, and you are in the right town without having planned it. None of that can be forced. It comes from softening. You drop the agenda and let whatever arrives arrive. Your timing sharpens until being out of step registers in the body as plainly as hunger. Your own face starts to show. The less you push, the more of you there is.

The feeling of being off the world is what this gift is made from. Felt all the way through, the lostness turns out to be the longing that points home. Once you can feel which way it points you are no longer lost. What you do with it for other people is the strange part. To orient someone you give no advice. You sit with them wanting nothing from them and in your company they find out that being afraid is allowed.
gene_keys.siddhi:
At the height of it you are home and you know it. The seeking is over. It ended by finding out there was never a distance to cross. There is the ground and there is you and no line where one stops and the other starts. Two people standing together are already a third thing, the pair itself, and there was never a two on its own. Being home is ordinary. It is the plainest thing you have ever felt, and it holds everything.

This is what the gift of being carried becomes when the one being carried lets go. Nothing is leading now and nothing is following. Life goes on moving and you are the ground it moves over, the way the seasons move over a field. What is left is soft.
gene_keys.programming_partner: Earth's Breath sits opposite you a second time because the Gene Keys pair these two as well. At their lowest the two feed each other. Its low season is a spark that will not catch and yours is the feeling of being nowhere, and each makes the other worse. Nothing starts because nothing seems to hold and nothing holds because nothing starts. Open it when the lost feeling has stopped everything from beginning. Something has to catch first.

human_design.gate:
Through this lens, the energy of being carried is the drive that gives a life its direction by receiving it. Gate 2 is the part of you that knows which way your life faces. It knows the way a field knows which way is downhill, by taking in what falls and letting it run. In you it runs as a pull toward a direction you cannot always justify out loud. Someone asks why you are going that way and the honest answer is that it is the way. It does not make the road. It feels where the road already goes. What belongs on the road is drawn toward you.

From outside a person moved like this looks like someone waiting. Nobody can see a direction being received, so they see the not-deciding and call it drift. What is happening is that the deciding is done by something quieter than the head and it works by letting things in. The people who carry this learn to let the direction arrive, and to let help in when it comes instead of carrying the whole road alone.
human_design.centre:
Seen through this lens, the energy of being carried runs through the centre of your chest, the Identity Centre. It holds who you are and where you are going, and those turn out to be one thing. It has no engine in it and works the way a magnet works. What a life needs is drawn toward it, and the direction of the life is the sum of what it drew.

In about six people in ten this centre is defined, fixed in place. If it is defined in you, there is a steady sense of self that does not move with the room and a direction that holds across years. What starves it is walking someone else's road. Do that for long and you lose heart. In the other four the centre is open. If it is open in you, you take on the identity of whoever is near and make it louder. You may have been many things in one life. Place matters more than anything. The wrong house or the wrong seat in a restaurant can put you out of yourself, and the right ground gives you back. What starves an open centre is trying to be somebody.

This energy does not pulse and it does not surge. It draws quietly all the time. What it needs from you is to hold still for long enough to feel which way you are already being pulled.
human_design.channel: What this drive receives has to be spent by something, or it stays a heading with nobody walking it. Its other half is Gate 14, Power Skills. That is the drive low in the body that works and makes more than one person needs. The Beat is what runs between them. The direction stops being a thing you carry and becomes a road you are on at a rhythm of stop and go that belongs to nobody else. Whether the other half sits in you or in someone near you, the beat only sounds where the two meet.

tarot.ring_role: This is a family of two. The other is Odyssey of Freedom, the self that stops imitating and shows its own face. What the two share is water. There is a sadness in water, a longing for the sea it came from. Both of you know it. Here it is the ground that lets the water soak in, and there it is the water that will not be told what shape to take. Open it when you have been carried far enough to wonder who is doing the travelling.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Three faces stand at the edge of the field the mare runs and one of them is looking for the road.

body.physiology:
Seen through the body, the energy of being carried sits at the sternum, the flat bone down the middle of the front of your chest. It is three pieces of bone in a line and by adulthood they are joined so well that you feel one plate. The collarbones hook onto its top. The first seven pairs of ribs meet it on either side through short lengths of cartilage. Behind it lie the heart and the great vessels leaving it. The plate is their shield. Inside it red marrow goes on making blood all your life.

Put two fingers on it now and breathe in. The plate lifts a little and the ribs swing out on their cartilage, and on the breath out it settles. It did none of that itself. The sternum has no muscle of its own that swings it. It goes where the ribs and the breath take it, a dozen or more times a minute. It has gone that way since your first breath.
body.amino_acid:
You have read the name phenylalanine more often than you think. It is printed on the side of many cans of diet drink. The sweetener in them is made from it. The can has to say so. It is one of the nine the body cannot make and has to eat, and it is in cheese and eggs and in beans and nuts.

Part of it is built into protein as it came. The rest goes to the liver and is changed there into a second building block, and the body makes two things from that one. It makes the signals that wake you and move you. And it makes the pigment of your skin and your hair and your eyes.

relations.unity_line: What you meet here is what the ground was made for, the force it receives and the self that grows once it is held.

pair.teaching: Earth's Breath is the fire that begins things, the force that comes down before anything can be received. These two are the first pair there is and neither makes a thing alone. That one burns. You carry what it lights. When the beginning has come and gone and something is left in your hands to bring through, you are here. Open it when the fire is up and you want the other side of it where nothing is started and everything is brought to its end.

inverse.teaching: Turned over, nothing here changes. It is one of eight that meet their own reflection and here the reason is plain. The ground has no back. Look at it from above or from below and it is the same field, holding whatever stands on it, with nothing hidden on the underside. Nothing turns up here that was not already here. What you are looking for on the far side of receiving is receiving.

programming_partner.teaching: Earth's Breath sits opposite you a second time because the Gene Keys pair these two as well. At their lowest the two feed each other. Its low season is a spark that will not catch and yours is the feeling of being nowhere, and each makes the other worse. Nothing starts because nothing seems to hold and nothing holds because nothing starts. Open it when the lost feeling has stopped everything from beginning. Something has to catch first.

codon_ring.name: Codon Ring of Water
codon_ring.teaching: This is a family of two. The other is Odyssey of Freedom, the self that stops imitating and shows its own face. What the two share is water. There is a sadness in water, a longing for the sea it came from. Both of you know it. Here it is the ground that lets the water soak in, and there it is the water that will not be told what shape to take. Open it when you have been carried far enough to wonder who is doing the travelling.

tarot.teaching: Three faces stand at the edge of the field the mare runs and one of them is looking for the road.

sky.teaching: the earth sign of the harvest, the one who sorts the grain from the straw and serves without asking for the credit. The mare's work, done in a field at the end of summer.

immortals.teaching: One of the eight stands for both halves of this doubled ground. Lan Cai He was the wanderer with a basket of flowers who sang in the street about how fast life goes and gave his coins away. He wore one shoe. Thick clothes in summer and a thin shirt in the snow, at home on any road because nothing was owned.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the smallest letter, a single stroke, the point every other letter starts from. The whole field begins as one thing received into an open hand.

cards.essence: This is the energy of a beginning. Something new is already alive in you and it does not have a shape yet. You can feel how real it is without being able to say what it will become. That mix of fullness and not knowing is what a beginning feels like from the inside.

glance.reading:
This is the energy of a beginning. Something new is already alive in you and it does not have a shape yet. You can feel how real it is without being able to say what it will become. That mix of fullness and not knowing is what a beginning feels like from the inside.

The challenge of this stretch is the pull to hurry. Not knowing what the thing will become is uncomfortable, and the discomfort asks you to settle it early. The beginning does not need settling. It needs room.

Let the beginning be a beginning. The new thing in you grows by small moves and it holds once its root has gone down. Take the next step and let it be rough. The part that feels like too little is the thing arriving.

iching.trigram_combination: Thunder under Water: a push from below, and above it a storm that has built and not broken. The traditional character draws a sprout pressing up through hard ground. Its root is already longer than its shoot.
iching.reading:
Something in you has begun, and it does not yet have ground to stand on. You feel both at once: the push to move, and the weight above it. You are full of what is coming, and there is nothing yet to show for it.

What this asks of you is simple. Do not set out for the goal yet. Gather what you have into a few strands and twist them into one cord you can hold. Find people who can carry part of it, and give them real charge. The rain is coming, so be ready for it rather than chasing it.

These two forces each have a place in the body. Thunder is the foot, the part of you that steps first. Water is the ear, which takes in what is coming before the eye can see it. Feel for both in yourself now.

Picture a horse, saddled and standing still. That is the posture this moment asks of you. Be ready to go, and stay where you are. The small moves that are right will come good. The big move made from here will fail. What is rich in you is still spreading inside and cannot yet shine out.
judgement_lines: The sprout. Through the difficulty, it grows all the way.
It goes well for the one who stays true.
Do not set out toward a goal yet. Put the helpers in their places.
image_lines: Clouds and thunder, the storm built and the rain not yet down.
So the wise sort the loose strands, and twist them into a cord that holds.

upper_trigram.name: Water (K'an)
upper_trigram.nature: Precipice, dangerous place. Stream, flowing water, river. Venture and fall. The middle son.

lower_trigram.name: Thunder (Chen)
lower_trigram.nature: Arousing power emerging from the depth of the earth. Excite, influence, move, affect. The eldest son.

lines.image: a post set in the ground, the marker that will not be moved.
lines.reading: You want to move forward and the ground says no. So you hesitate, and the hesitation is right. Instead of pushing on, set something down that stays put. Make one fixed point where people can find you. Stay where you are and let them come, and value the ones nobody counts. Everything that gathers later begins with one point that did not move.

lines.image: a horse saddled and standing still, and riders coming who are not raiders but suitors.
lines.reading: Hoofbeats come out of the dust and you brace for trouble. They have come to ask for you. Someone wants to join what you are starting. The offer is real and the timing is not yours yet. Say no to the early union and let a whole cycle pass, however long that is in your life. What is joined too soon does not hold. What is joined in its time comes to a house that can keep it.

lines.image: chasing a deer into a forest with no guide.
lines.reading: Something flashes ahead of you and you go after it alone. The ground is unknown and no one with you can read it. Eagerness like this mistakes what it is chasing. Turn around while the way back is still visible. Going deeper here ends in nothing, and a good beginning is lost in it.

lines.image: the same horse, and this time it moves toward the meeting.
lines.reading: The same horse and the same saddle, and now it moves. What changed is that you have stopped trying to make the beginning alone. Someone has been reaching toward you, and you go to meet them. Take the parts of the work that you have kept apart and let them join. Do the same with the parts of yourself. Seeking and going are one motion here, and there is light in it. Go.

lines.image: the sprout full of sap, the oil in the press not yet poured.
lines.reading: The good part is here. What you have been growing has gathered inside you, and you are full with it. What has not happened yet is the pouring: the way out is still too narrow for everything you carry. Keep to small acts that are right, and they will prosper. Reach for the big gesture from here and it fails. The gift is still spreading in you and cannot shine yet.

lines.image: the horse saddled and standing, and tears that run like blood.
lines.reading: At the top of the difficulty the strength for it has run out. You are in the saddle and the horse will not go. There is nothing left to drive it with. Then the weeping. Nobody can say how long this lasts. Sometimes an effort has simply ended. Grieve it honestly. Then begin again, smaller.

iching.symbol:
One whole line sits at the very bottom and one high in the fifth place. The lines between are open. Something has started and something holds above it. The middle is not settled yet.

Read from the bottom up: the bottom line is where this begins, the top line is where it ends. A whole line pushes; a broken line gives way.

gene_keys.shadow:
At its lowest this energy is the fear that what you rely on will not stay. Some part of you knows you will die and lose all of it. So the hands close. They close on the people and the work as if holding could make them stay. The disorder you are afraid of is the shaking of your own grip, and it sits under ordinary days as a low unease. A threat to one of them only shows you how hard you have been holding. When one thing gives way the usual move is to find something new to hold before the fear can reach you. That works for a while. The fear stays underneath, because it is made in you and life did not put it there.

The way through is to feel the fear itself. It lives low in the belly as a tremor and it asks only to be felt. Stay with it and it comes all the way up. What felt like the ground going turns out to be something starting. What was under the fear was love, and it had been holding you the whole time.
gene_keys.repressive: This is the person who holds everything in place. The day is planned and the plan is checked and the breath is kept small so nothing can move. From outside it looks like steadiness. Nothing in there has been allowed to change for years, and only touching the fear itself will loosen it.
gene_keys.reactive: This person throws the fear out as anger. A fight gets picked and a plan gets blown up and a room gets wrecked. The very mess the fear was about is now outside where it can be seen. It has no direction and no rhythm. Every small anger that goes unowned adds to it.
gene_keys.gift:
This is the gift of making something new out of what is changing. You can work while the ground moves. You try things, and most of them fail, and the failing is how the new shape is found. A child at play does exactly this, the same thing again a little differently until something new appears. It is the best feeling you know. You could do it all day and you have stopped making things alone. What is around you gets in and changes you. Other people's hands end up in the work and the work is better for it.

The fear that what you rely on will not stay is what this gift is made from. The unease under it is the feeling of something starting. When the hands stop closing on it, that same shake is what they get to work with. What was dread is the tremor of a new shape finding itself. The trying still needs one steady thing. Keep the best version of what you are making in view and give the energy to that. Let the path stay unfound. You can love the work now without needing it to stay.
gene_keys.siddhi:
At its height this energy is the innocence of someone who has been through everything and opened again. You have lost what you held more than once and are still delighted by what arrives. The hands are open because there is nothing left to protect. The very old have it and so does a small child and the difference is that you know. No one is in control. The child in you wants to see what happens.

This is what the gift of making new things becomes when even the maker lets go. Life moves through you and starts what it starts. You know how it ends and nobody knows the road, and the road is the play. You can grieve on the outside and underneath watch the play go on, and even the grief is part of it. What is left under all of it is love. Every beginning arrives new and you have seen enough to know.
gene_keys.programming_partner: The Gene Keys set this card opposite Melt Into Perfection, the slow refining of what is already there. You bring the new thing raw. It holds the standard and cooks out what is wrong one habit at a time. Each is the other's missing half: a beginning with nothing to test it against and a refining with nothing new to refine. Open it when you keep starting and nothing keeps. What you are bringing has to pass through what is already cooking.

human_design.gate:
Through this lens, the energy of beginning is the pressure to bring something new into a shape that can last. Gate 3 is the drive that takes what has never existed and finds the form it can live in. Without it nothing new would ever settle into the world. In you it runs as an urge to get the raw thing into some order the moment it arrives. You try a shape and then another. You keep going until one holds. That is the gift: you can stay with the mess long enough for the order to appear.

From outside the trying looks like disorder, and you may be called a starter who never finishes. What is happening is that the shape has to be found by trying, and most tries do not hold. The people who carry this all their lives learn to let the tries be tries. They trust that the order they were pressing for arrives one working piece at a time.
human_design.centre:
Seen through this lens, the energy of beginning runs through the Sacral in you. That is the centre low in the body between the navel and the legs. It is the engine of a life. It is the energy that gets up and works and makes and renews itself by being used. Something in you is trying to begin, and this is the place it begins from.

The Sacral does not think. It responds. Put the new thing in front of it and a sound rises before your mind has a say. A lift means yes. A flatness means no. In seven people in ten the Sacral is defined. If it is defined in you, that response is the most trustworthy thing you have about this beginning. If it is open you feel the pull of everyone else's yes. The question is which one is yours.

This energy does not move steadily. It pulses. There is a surge to start and then a still stretch where nothing moves and then the next surge. The still stretch is where you will want to quit. It is the engine gathering. Feel low for the lift when the new thing is in front of you. If it is there, the fuel is there. If it is flat, deciding from above will not make it run.
human_design.channel: The pressure to give a new thing a shape needs a limit to stand against. Its other half is Gate 60, Limitation, which accepts what cannot be changed and works inside it. The Channel of Mutation is the raw urge to order what is new, held inside a boundary that gives it something to push against. This is how anything genuinely new enters the world and stays. Whether the other half sits in you or in someone near you, the change only happens where the two meet.

tarot.ring_role: This card belongs to a family of six that hold one whole life between them. This one begins it. The others are the watching and the cutting away, then the return and the feeding, then the finishing. What the six share is a trust in what looks like a mess. The mess is where life finds its next shape. Every one of them knows it from a different point in the life. Open any of them to see that trust further along. Here it is the first breath.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Clouds and thunder, the rain not yet down: five faces wait in that weather.

body.physiology:
Seen through the body, the energy of beginning sits at the navel, the one place on you where a beginning was once made under a cut supply. The navel is a scar, and every person carries one. Before you were born a cord ran into it with one vein and two arteries inside, and everything that fed you came in through that vein. In your first minutes the cord was cut and the vessels closed on their own. The vein became a cord of tissue running up to the liver, the two arteries became cords running down to the bladder, and all three still hold, tied into the front wall at the one point where the supply came in.

Now the navel stays shut. Press a finger into it and you meet something firm at once. Press to either side and it sinks. That firm point is where the cord came in, and it has not opened since. Something in you began there without anything being ready.
body.amino_acid:
The building block this energy answers to is leucine. It has a fork in its shape, and the fork puts it with two others that muscle takes apart for itself instead of sending to the liver. It is one of the nine you cannot make and have to eat, and it is the strongest signal a cell gets to start building protein. It is in every whole protein. A plate of eggs or beans brings it in.

After a meal with protein in it the amount in your blood rises, and muscle reads the rise as the order to begin repair. Between meals it falls and the order stops. Since the cord was cut, the order to begin building has come in from outside, meal by meal.

relations.unity_line: Read alongside UL 4, this is the whole arc of first arrival, the birth that comes in a storm and the long apprenticeship after it.

pair.teaching: Veils of Knowledge is this beginning a season on. The shoot is up and does not yet know what it is. The not-knowing has moved from your belly to your head. This card asks you to wait. That one asks you to ask once and then listen. Open it when the thing has started and you have begun hunting for the reason. The two are one arrival: the push out and the schooling of what pushed out.

inverse.teaching: Veils of Knowledge is this beginning a season on. The shoot is up and does not yet know what it is. The not-knowing has moved from your belly to your head. This card asks you to wait. That one asks you to ask once and then listen. Open it when the thing has started and you have begun hunting for the reason. The two are one arrival: the push out and the schooling of what pushed out.

programming_partner.teaching: The Gene Keys set this card opposite Melt Into Perfection, the slow refining of what is already there. You bring the new thing raw. It holds the standard and cooks out what is wrong one habit at a time. Each is the other's missing half: a beginning with nothing to test it against and a refining with nothing new to refine. Open it when you keep starting and nothing keeps. What you are bringing has to pass through what is already cooking.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Life and Death
codon_ring.teaching: This card belongs to a family of six that hold one whole life between them. This one begins it. The others are the watching and the cutting away, then the return and the feeding, then the finishing. What the six share is a trust in what looks like a mess. The mess is where life finds its next shape. Every one of them knows it from a different point in the life. Open any of them to see that trust further along. Here it is the first breath.

tarot.teaching: Clouds and thunder, the rain not yet down: five faces wait in that weather.

sky.teaching: the sign of what has to die in order to change, a depth that keeps what it holds until it is transformed. A seed rots a little in this ground before it splits.

immortals.teaching: Two who began again in poor circumstances go with this card. Li Tie Guai was the healer who came home to find his body burned and started over inside a dead beggar's body on an iron crutch with a gourd of medicine. Cao Guojiu walked out of a palace in disgust at his family and in the stories became the patron of the stage. One began again in a borrowed body and the other in a chosen poverty.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the letter of life carried whole through moving water. What passes through this beginning comes out the other side still alive.

cards.essence: There is a not-knowing in you that is the start of learning. You have come up against something you cannot make sense of and you want to. That wanting is young and it is honest. It is the state every person is in before they understand anything. It is worth more than a shelf of answers because it is the one thing that can still be taught.

glance.reading:
There is a not-knowing in you that is the start of learning. You have come up against something you cannot make sense of and you want to. That wanting is young and it is honest. It is the state every person is in before they understand anything. It is worth more than a shelf of answers because it is the one thing that can still be taught.

The pull this cycle brings is to keep asking why. You ask a friend and then you ask them again and then you ask someone else. Every asking muddies what the first one gave you. What you are looking for was already in it.

Ask someone who knows more than you, and ask once. Then stop and let what you were told do its work. Do the small things well while it does. Understanding does not come back by the road the question went out on. It comes up through you later, once you have let it be.

iching.trigram_combination: Under a great mass of rock a spring is coming out of the ground. That is Mountain over Water. The water at the source is clear and has no idea where it is going. Above it the mountain stops the view and stops the water spreading, so it gathers at the foot. Danger below and stillness above. Something young is growing under a cover.
iching.reading:
Something has come up in you that you do not understand. You are the young one in this. Everything that ever grew was covered like this once before it knew what it was. You are ready to learn and you do not yet know what you need. The one thing you can feel clearly is the wanting to know.

What this asks of you is to go and ask. Find the one who knows the ground and ask them once and mean it. Then take what they say and carry it off without a word. The first answer is the clear one. Ask the same thing a second and a third time and you are no longer asking. You are stirring, and the water goes cloudy with every stir. A clouded answer is worse than none. Stay firm in the meantime and keep doing the plain things right. Plain things done all the way through are what a character is made of.

These two forces each have a place in the body. Mountain is the hand, which can hold still and keep a thing steady. Water is the ear, the part of you that takes something in without needing to see it. Hold still and listen. That is the whole posture here, and from outside it looks like nothing.

There is real danger underneath you, the danger of not knowing. Stop at the edge of it. Do not go down there alone.
judgement_lines: Youthful Folly. It goes through. I do not go looking for the young one. The young one comes looking for me.
The first time you ask, I answer. Ask twice and three times and the water is muddied, and a muddied question gets no answer.
Hold firm, and it goes well.
image_lines: A spring comes out at the foot of the mountain.
So the wise do each thing all the way through, and a character grows from that.

upper_trigram.name: Mountain (Ken)
upper_trigram.nature: Limit, frontier, stillness. Solid, steady, unshakable. The youngest son.

lower_trigram.name: Water (K'an)
lower_trigram.nature: Precipice, dangerous place. Stream, flowing water, river. Venture and fall. The middle son.

lines.image: discipline at the start, and the shackles taken off again.
lines.reading: At the very beginning of not knowing, a rule does more good than kindness. Someone sets a limit on you or you set one on yourself, and the limit is what opens the eyes. Take it. Then let it come off. A restraint kept on past its use stops teaching and starts binding, and the one who goes on being punished learns only shame. Use the rule once and lose it.

lines.image: patience with the ones who do not know, a wife brought into the house, and the son running it.
lines.reading: Here you are the one who knows a little, and the not-knowing around you is yours to bear with. Do it kindly. Take in what is soft and unfinished and let it into the house, the way a wife is brought in. The young one you were patient with can run the place now. Strength that bends toward the weak is what keeps a household going.

lines.image: the one who throws herself at whoever looks rich, and no good in taking her.
lines.reading: Somebody is latching on. It may be a person attaching themselves to you because you seem to have something. It may be you, running toward whoever looks strong and losing yourself on the way. Either way there is no gain in it. What is given away that fast was never held. Stand on your own feet and let people come to you with what they have.

lines.image: shut in with the not-knowing, and nobody near who knows.
lines.reading: This is being in the dark without knowing it is dark. You have kept company with people who know no more than you do, and the one who could have shown you the way is nowhere near. So the not-knowing has closed round you like a windowless room. The shame of it is real and it is also the way out. Real teachers do not hide from you. Go and find one.

lines.image: not knowing the way a child does not know, open and ready to be shown.
lines.reading: There is a way of not knowing that is a gift. A child does not know and does not mind that it does not know. It asks and takes the answer whole. That is you here, and it goes well. Stay open and let someone who knows more take you by the hand. Being unable and following the able is the plain path through. What was covered comes clear without forcing.

lines.image: striking at the not-knowing, and the line between guarding and robbing.
lines.reading: At the top the not-knowing has to be struck, because it has gone on too long and harm is coming from it. Strike it. Only be careful which side of the line you are on. Beating the ignorance out of someone makes you the one doing harm. Keep harm off them instead. Guard against the robber without becoming one, and the two of you end up on the same side.

gene_keys.shadow:
The mind is stirring the water. At its lowest this energy is a mind that cannot leave a question alone, and every stir makes the water cloudier. It has a bad day and decides it does not like someone. By evening it has a list of good reasons. Underneath the reasons is a feeling with logic wrapped round it, and the logic only measures what it set out to find. Intolerance is a slant put on the mind by a fear underneath. Sit alone in a room for an hour with nothing to do and it shows itself as a mind you cannot stand to be in. Under all of it is a hunger for an answer that will finally make you feel safe. No answer ever has, so the next question is already forming. Sureness in the head does not make the body feel safe.

The way through is to look at the other side of your own opinion until you find the fear it was standing on. The questions are the seed. Kept up long enough they wear the mind out, and a worn-out mind is one that can finally stop stirring.
gene_keys.repressive: One person gives up on understanding. The mind goes slack and calls itself open. No opinion is held about anything, because holding one would mean being answerable for it. They think they are slower than other people. They are frightened, and the fright has emptied the thinking out.
gene_keys.reactive: Another person makes the mind the judge and waits for it to deliver peace. It never does, so they get angry with whoever was supposed to have the answers. The anger comes out on the smallest thing, the misplaced word. Every complaint lets off a little of it and none of them is the point.
gene_keys.gift:
Left still the water runs clear on its own. Understanding is what this energy becomes when it is met. It is a knowing that arrives in the whole of you and floods up through the body from the belly. It comes after the mind has looked at a thing from every side and found that every side can be argued. At that moment something gives. You stop needing to be right, because you have seen that logic can prove anything. The mind is let off the job of settling your life. Then it is free to do what it is good at. It looks at patterns and turns them over and plays. You see both halves of any argument and take neither, and you understand people the same way. The restlessness is still there and now it points outward toward what could be put right in the world.

The questions were the fuel for this. It was the hunger for an answer, pushed all the way to exhaustion, that broke the mind open. Nothing has to be defended now. The answer comes as a feeling in the body that the question is finished with.
gene_keys.siddhi:
The spring has left the mountain and runs out to everyone. This energy at its height is forgiveness, a warmth that goes through the borders between people and finds there was never a debt on either side. Nothing was personal. The mind that needed a reason for what happened has died, and in its place is a plainness that watches the old story and does not pick it up. It is quiet here, with nothing restless left in it.

This is what understanding becomes when even the one who understood lets go. You cannot do it. It arrives when you are tired enough of the drama. It lands like a surprise and something in the chest that had been choked comes open. It goes back down the line of the people you came from and unties what they left tied. The old debts are cancelled at the source. The water has gone on past the mountain and anyone can drink.
gene_keys.programming_partner: Union in the Ashes is the pole set against you, the heat that goes up before a thought arrives. At their lowest the two feed each other. The flash of reaction gives the mind something to be intolerant about and the mind hands the flash its reasons. Now the heat has an argument. Open it when your reasons have started to feel hot. The whole thing may have begun below the neck.

human_design.gate:
Wired into the body, the not-knowing is a pressure to make sense of things. It does not rest until something fits. Gate 4 is the part of you that takes a pile of loose facts and finds the shape they make. It is where an answer is formed. The gift is that the world stops being a blur. You can take what is confused and turn it into something a person can use and explain it in words they can follow. In you it runs as a mind that puzzles at everything. It has to know how a thing works before it can leave the thing alone. It is happiest when a pattern finally closes.

From outside a person like this gets called a know-it-all or the one with an answer for everything. What is really going on is that the answers are how the mind tries to make life safe. Every one of them is a guess that fitted. An answer held as a possibility can be dropped the moment a better one comes. A mind that can drop its answers stays light.
human_design.centre:
This pressure runs in the head at the Ajna Centre, the place behind the brow where what comes in gets sorted into sense. It takes the questions that press down from the crown and turns them into something usable. It has no engine. It can see and it cannot act. What it works out has to be carried somewhere else before anything happens.

In about half of people this centre is defined. If it is defined in you, your mind runs all the time and you cannot switch it off. You are also built to feel sure. The sureness is a ground and a trap in one because you can be certain and wrong. In the other half the centre is open. If it is open in you, there is no fixed way you make sense of things. You take in the thinking of whoever is near and make it louder. You are not built to be certain. The harder you grip a thought the less you can see with it. Held lightly, an open mind of this kind sees a thing from more sides than a fixed one ever will.

What this energy needs is a real question to work on and someone who wants the answer. It starves on being ignored and on being made to decide. The same answer is help at one moment and an intrusion at the next.
human_design.channel: An answer with nothing to test it stays a guess. The doubt it needs is Gate 63 at the crown. It is called Curiosity, the pressure of a question that will not accept a thing as finished. The Channel of Logic runs between the two. The question presses down and the answer forms and the question checks it again until something can be relied on. It is a slow wiring and it waits to be asked before it speaks. Whether the other half sits in you or in someone near you, the checking only happens where the two meet.

tarot.ring_role: Four make up this family that works out how people manage to be together. One is the yes that goes all the way in. Another is the closeness that breaks through a guard, and the third is the gathering that gives a crowd its shape. This one is the mind in the middle of it. It is the part of a bond that wants reasons and has to learn to do without them. What the four share is union. Here it is the reason nobody had to give.
tarot.tarot_resonance: A spring under a mountain draws a crowd of faces, and most of them are teachers.

body.physiology:
In the body itself the not-knowing sits in the neocortex, the thin folded layer over the outside of the brain. It is a sheet of cells a few millimetres thick and six layers deep. It wraps the older brain the way a rind wraps fruit. It is folded so tightly that about two thirds of it is hidden in the creases. Words and plans and sums are made here and so are the reasons you give for things. It is the newest part of you and the last to finish. The front of it is where judgement is made and it is still being wired into your middle twenties.

Look at any word on this page. You cannot see it as marks. The meaning arrives before you can stop it. The arriving is this layer at work, doing in a fraction of a second what it took years to learn. Now look at the same word and try to un-read it. What this layer has learned it cannot put down.
body.amino_acid:
Valine hides in the fold. When a protein folds up the parts of it that cannot stand water turn inward. Valine is one of those parts. It usually ends up buried in the middle, away from the water.

You cannot make it and have to eat it. Milk and cheese carry it and so do meat and eggs and soy. Whole grains hold more of it than of some of its kind, so a bowl of oats has it. It is one of three with a branch in its shape. Muscle takes those three apart for itself rather than sending them to the liver. The whole shape of a protein holds because of what is tucked away inside it.

relations.unity_line: The company here is a schoolroom, the one who has just arrived and the one who cannot help reacting and the family that has to learn to live together, with the teachers on the wall.

pair.teaching: Messengers of the Infinite is the season before this one, the push out of the ground that had no idea what it was pushing toward. Here the shoot is up and asking. Back there the whole strain was still below the surface and nobody could be asked anything. Turn either card over and you get the other. Open it when the question has gone quiet and something in you has started pushing again with no name on it.

inverse.teaching: Messengers of the Infinite is the season before this one, the push out of the ground that had no idea what it was pushing toward. Here the shoot is up and asking. Back there the whole strain was still below the surface and nobody could be asked anything. Turn either card over and you get the other.
